_about: Copy this file to research/isrid-submissions/config.json (gitignored) and replace every <...> value. backend/isrid_submission.py refuses to run until it is filled in. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
team_slug: <team-slug, lower-case, used in the outgoing file name: isrid-<team-slug>-<quarter>-<run>.csv>
_county: D4H exports the STATE in its County column by design. The script writes this value there for every in-county row.
county: <Your county, as ISRID should record it>
_places: Every city, town and unincorporated place in your county, spelled the way D4H's City column spells them. A row whose City is not on this list is flagged as possible mutual aid; the dispatcher confirms every flag.
_eligible_from: Incidents dated before this day are never selected. Set it to the first day your team's records are good enough to publish.
_d4h_env: The deploy.env ENV_NAME whose gcloud configuration reads production D4H (the skill's Step 3 uses it).
